branches.error.loadFailed: no branch inventory — run the full collection ("pnpm collect:branches")
branches.error.noBranchesDesc: {msg}. The inventory comes from the FULL collection — a light recollection does not update branches.json.
branches.error.noGithubDesc: {msg} — the PR↔branch link degrades to 'no link' and the derived statuses (alive without PR, parked via squash) switch off.
branches.error.githubPrs: {msg} to generate public/data/github.json (requires an authenticated gh).
branches.freshness.tooltip: branches collected at {date} — only the full collection refreshes it
branches.coverage.tooltip: {covered} of {total} PRs have headRef — PRs from caches older than the link stay out of the join; 'no link' does not mean 'no PR'. A full GitHub recollection normalizes it.
branches.card.pousadas.title: Parked — safe to delete
branches.card.pousadas.desc: ahead 0 (already merged) or released through squash-merge, inactive for {n}+ days.
branches.card.pousadas.empty: No parked branch in the current filters.
branches.card.abandonadas.title: Abandoned — stalled unreleased work
branches.card.abandonadas.desc: ahead > 0 with no open PR, stalled for {n}+ days — the work never reached production.
branches.card.abandonadas.empty: No abandoned branch in the current filters.
branches.card.skew.title: develop × production
branches.card.skew.desc: Integration ref skew against production per repo: ahead = unreleased work; behind with ahead 0 = abandoned integration.
branches.card.skew.empty: No integration ref with skew in the current filters.
branches.tooltip.squashReleased: released through squash-merge — ahead > 0 is rewritten history, not pending work
branches.tooltip.abandonada: commits ahead of production with no open PR, stalled for {n}+ days — unreleased work
branches.tooltip.vivaSemPr: commits ahead of production or not merged into the integration ref, with no open PR
branches.table.title: Branches
branches.table.footer: current inventory (full collection) — the period filter does not apply · ahead/behind = commits WITHOUT merges vs each repo's production ref · parked = ahead 0 and no activity for ≥ {n} days · "no link" ≠ "no PR": PRs from old caches may lack headRef
branches.pr.noLinkNoPr: no PR with headRef for this branch — an old cache may lack the field (partial coverage)
branches.dev.notFoundDesc: That name does not appear in the collected commits. Check the spelling or run pnpm collect.
branches.repos.notFoundDesc: That name does not appear in the collected data. Check the spelling or run pnpm collect.
branches.repos.noTags: This repo has no tags — no release recorded.
branches.repos.showing: showing the {shown} most recent of {total} tags
branches.repos.cardCycleTime: median cycle time (PRs of the month)
